Rasha Thadani & Ibrahim Ali Khan Walk Hand In Hand As Showstoppers At India Couture Week 2025
Last Updated:
July 31, 2025, 09:00 IST
Movies
Videos
Rasha Thadani and Ibrahim Ali Khan took to the runway as showstoppers for designer JJ Valaya at India Couture Week 2025 on 30 July. The celebrated couturier unveiled ‘East’, a collection inspired by the West’s historic fascination with the mystique of the East.
